issues.description: Constructor signature differs between the template and the provided solution. The template class GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit defines __init__(self, num_qubits: int) (expects a num_qubits parameter), while the solution implements __init__(self) with no parameter. This mismatch can confuse students about how to instantiate the class and prevents straightforward comparison to the reference solution or reuse of solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signatures consistent. Either remove the unused num_qubits parameter from the template __init__ so it matches the solution (def __init__(self):) or update the solution to accept num_qubits and use it to set up the query register. Ensure the problem statement / exercise instructions mention whether the constructor should accept a number-of-qubits argument so students know which pattern to follow.
